capabilities: Converts selected text between upper, lower, title, sentence and capitalized case
Converts names to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, slug and similar forms
Joins hard-wrapped lines and rejoins words split across a line break
Strips invisible characters and ligatures and straightens quotes and dashes
Sorts, deduplicates and trims lines and runs saved find-and-replace commands
extras: Runs entirely offline with no telemetry; Tidy on paste is off by default. Interface available in nine languages. The author sells optional paid extras for other plugins in the same family.
intentEvidence: This is a rebuild of the uncontested half of Text Format, whose last release was in July 2024.
motivation: A rebuild of the half of the Text Format plugin the author considered worth keeping, with that plugin's open bugs fixed by design.
problem: Text pasted from PDFs, scans or web pages arrives with broken line wraps, ligatures, invisible characters and inconsistent casing, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to fix it.

relations.evidence: This is a rebuild of the uncontested half of Text Format, whose last release was in July 2024.

summary: Command set that changes the case of selected text and cleans up prose copied from PDFs, scans or web pages.
